note: Ripley County MO has a county planning commission that handles rezonings, but no zoning district layer was found on its website, the county GIS directory, ArcGIS Hub or ArcGIS Online (searches for Ripley County zoning/parcels returned nothing). Only commercial plat-book and parcel viewers (Acres, Mapping Solutions, Rockford) exist, none a public queryable zoning service.
